'''Na'Lora''' was an individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Na'Lora was the manager of a [[Tarasin]] band. During the celebrations for [[Cularin's 200th anniversary]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Na'Lora was present in [[Vanster Enan's Sop House]] in [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where the band was playing.
